description_excerpt: Job Requirements The Apparel Quality team helps ensure Brooks apparel consistently meets quality expectations by strengthening vendor capability, maintaining clear standards, and driving continuous improvement across manufacturing partners to support the runner experience. As Senior QA Engineer, Apparel, you will oversee quality assurance and control for production processes, work in progress, and finished apparel at Brooks Tier 1 factories to uphold Brooks Global Quality and production standards.
